tools.name: get_descriptor
tools.description: Return the TrustAI Verification MCP self-description: operator, what the server verifies, the public tools, the boundary it never crosses (it never adjudicates), and links to the public surfaces.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: Return the structural checks this server performs on legal-AI output, and — explicitly — what it never claims. Information, not legal advice.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Return server health: process uptime and a deterministic engine self-check (the structural detectors run on a fixed sample and return the expected flag counts). Local-only; no database on the path.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "review_legal_text" is 1449 chars, far longer than this server's median (196). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
